displayName: OCI-AUTH-021: Authentication — Privileged Account Anomalous Login
description:
Detects anomalous login patterns for privileged accounts outside normal hours or locations

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_auth_021", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%authentication%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%privileged%') AND "value" > 0
